name: An exact and heuristic framework for rolling stock rescheduling with railway infrastructure availability constraints
description: Mined from An exact and heuristic framework for rolling stock rescheduling with railway infrastructure availability constraints (Transportation Research Part B Methodological, 2025).

provenance.reference: An exact and heuristic framework for rolling stock rescheduling with railway infrastructure availability constraints
provenance.author: Jia Hui Zhu; Twan Dollevoet; Dennis Huisman

indices.name: M
indices.description: Set of rolling stock unit types

indices.name: fam_c
indices.description: family a shape read off the formulas names

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Weight for objective function components

parameters.name: carr
parameters.description: Carriage kilometers for composition c

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Headway time for activity

parameters.name: l
parameters.description: Lower bound for activity duration

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: Seat capacity for composition c on trip t

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Original planned composition for trip t

parameters.name: o
parameters.description: Original number of coupled/uncoupled units

parameters.name: R
parameters.description: Set of real numbers (domain indicator)

parameters.name: D
parameters.description: End of time horizon in minutes

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Number of units of type m in composition c that become part of successor composition cp

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: Number of units of type m in composition c that are removed when transitioning to successor composition cp

parameters.name: d_plus_max
parameters.description: Maximum positive delay allowed for a train

parameters.name: i_0
parameters.description: Initial inventory of rolling stock units of type m at station s

parameters.name: i_end
parameters.description: Target end-of-day inventory of rolling stock units of type m at station s

parameters.name: pi
parameters.description: Penalty or big-M parameter for event j

parameters.name: rho
parameters.description: Weighting parameter in the objective function

parameters.name: tau
parameters.description: Time-related parameter (departure/arrival time)

parameters.name: w_1
parameters.description: Weight coefficient 1 in the objective function

parameters.name: w_2
parameters.description: Weight coefficient 2 in the objective function

parameters.name: w_3
parameters.description: Weight coefficient 3 in the objective function

parameters.name: w_4
parameters.description: Weight coefficient 4 in the objective function

parameters.name: w_5
parameters.description: Weight coefficient 5 in the objective function

parameters.name: w_6
parameters.description: Weight coefficient 6 in the objective function

parameters.name: w_7
parameters.description: Weight coefficient 7 in the objective function

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Number of uncoupled units

parameters.name: l_ij_on_X
parameters.description: derived: l[i, j] at X[n]

parameters.name: u_idx_E_E
parameters.description: derived: u written over (E, E); declared over (M, T)

parameters.name: u_ij_on_X
parameters.description: derived: u[i, j] at X[n]

parameters.name: h_ij_on_X
parameters.description: derived: h[i, j] at X[n]

variables.name: x
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if composition c is chosen for trip t

variables.name: I
variables.description: Inventory of rolling stock units at station after departure

variables.name: p
variables.description: Binary variable indicating different composition than planned

variables.name: z
variables.description: Binary variable for composition change from c to c' for trip t

variables.name: X
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if shunting movement is canceled

variables.name: q
variables.description: Binary variable for order of events

variables.name: p_diff
variables.description: Indicator whether trip t is served by a composition different from the planned one

variables.name: I_end
variables.description: End-of-day inventory of rolling stock units of type m at station s

variables.name: I_off
variables.description: Off-balance inventory deviation of rolling stock units of type m at station s

variables.name: c_idx_T
variables.description: second variable written c: over (T), where c is declared over (M, T); row eq_0011 writes both forms; domain taken from c

constraints.name: eq_0004
constraints.description: Linking x and z for successor trips (eq. 3)

constraints.name: eq_0005
constraints.description: Linking x and z for predecessor trips (eq. 4)

constraints.name: eq_0034
constraints.description: Domain of event time and absolute deviation (eq. 33)
